response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.observstation IN (SELECT t2.observstation FROM telescopes t2 WHERE t2.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND t2.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC, t.observstation LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The equipment-status condition only decides which stations are kept. Once a station qualifies, all of its matched telescopes are averaged and counted, including those in 'Maintenance' or with a missing status.
Ties in telescope count are broken by station name so the top 10 is deterministic.
